deployments_detail.use: Genius Results, a self-service internal support AI trained on over 1 million past incidents and 6,000 help articles to resolve employee/support issues. [Nike (internal)]
deployments_detail.value: trained on 1M+ incidents and 6,000 help articles

deployments_detail.use: Nike A.I.R. (Athlete Imagined Revolution): generative-AI-assisted footwear design that turns athlete listening sessions into hundreds of concept images, combined with computational design, AI simulation, and 3D printing to create 13 athlete-specific Air prototypes. [Nike (generative AI design tools)]
deployments_detail.value: 13 prototypes for 13 athletes; concepts generated in seconds vs months

deployments_detail.use: Celect demand-sensing/predictive-analytics platform (acquired 2019) used to forecast demand and determine which inventory to forward-position in distribution centers to optimize delivery speed and fulfillment cost, enabling 1-2 day shipping. [Celect (Nike acquisition)]
deployments_detail.value: order cycle times cut by up to 50%

deployments_detail.use: Nike Fit: AI + augmented reality foot-scanning feature in the Nike App that uses computer vision and machine learning to collect 13 data points mapping foot morphology and recommend hyper-accurate shoe sizes. [Nike (computer vision / ML)]

More than 1,000 collaborative robots (cobots) deployed across Nike distribution centers to sort, pack, and move products, working alongside human 'teammates' to speed order processing; part of Nike's AI/ML-driven supply chain transformation. [Nike (cobot fleet)]

NikeAI Beta, a conversational generative-AI shopping assistant in the Nike App (iOS, US) that lets shoppers describe needs in plain language (e.g. 'running shoes for a 5k') and returns personalized product recommendations. Built on 'best in class foundational models fine-tuned by domain experts.' [Undisclosed foundation models (fine-tuned in-house)]

AI-powered agentic shopping experience with Google: Nike products discoverable and purchasable directly in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Google Search, using Google's Universal Commerce Protocol multi-item checkout with Google Wallet. [Google (Gemini, AI Mode, Universal Commerce Protocol)]

NikeKIT, a personalized AI shopping assistant proof-of-concept built by agency Rangle using OpenAI text-generation RAG with mixed embeddings over real-time conversation, member data, and enriched product catalog; auto-tagged 6,300+ SKUs and served Nike's 170M+ loyalty members. [Rangle / OpenAI / Next.js / Vercel]
deployments_detail.value: 6,300+ SKUs tagged in 1 day; 8-day PoC, 21-day delivery

deployments_detail.use: Zodiac (acquired 2018), a predictive customer-analytics/AI tool integrated into the Nike App to estimate customer lifetime value and drive personalized product recommendations and content across platforms. [Zodiac (Nike acquisition)]
GenAI product design (custom LLM on athlete data, e.g. A.I.R. project) + Celect AI demand forecasting + AI-powered shopping (Google)
AgentAutosys, an internal AI/agentic tool that automatically detects and resolves batch/data job failures, handling thousands of alerts to keep Nike's technology operations running. [Nike (internal)]
